verdict.rationale: Circle's Agent Wallets let an AI agent hold funds and transact onchain autonomously "within spending policies you define," with customizable spending controls and compliance guardrails. Agent Nanopayments and the Circle CLI add documented flows for an agent to pay for x402 services and transfer USDC. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the policy types and limits (e.g. caps, allowlists, approvals), an agent-initiated fiat payout flow (CPN payouts are not tied to agents), and any independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
